topic: Part 5 Test 1 — Sydney-Perth kill-shot post-c5-patches + EXP-563 verification
summary_for_decider: All 4 fresh-rewrite checks passed. Three patches verified landed cleanly: (1) H5 grammar fix — disc-radius sentence now correctly precedes 'This is not a prediction confirmed' in Summary, orphan fragment gone, no seam artifacts; (2) H1 55-60S drop — unsourced latitude-mismatch sentence removed, clean globe-geometry derivation (13,691 km at 70S) retained; (3) EXP-563 sphere-in-disguise pre-empt — all 6 key phrases confirmed present in Problem 4, old 'at that point the dome has lost its geometric distinctiveness / renamed globe projection' phrasing fully replaced, §7.1 cross-reference intact. Kill-shot prose is now structurally sound across Summary and Problem 4. ISS-2505 (§7.1 parallel patch) remains open per decider.

check1_terminology.notes: EXP-563 introduces new terms: 'sphere in disguise on the geometric-distance test' (replaces plain 'sphere in disguise'), 'metric incoherence', 'metric capitulation', 'parameter-coherence'. All confirmed present. No stale variant ('at that point the dome has lost its geometric distinctiveness', 'become a renamed globe projection') found anywhere in part5 html.

check2_seam_artifacts.notes: No double-period, double-comma, double-space, or orphan semicolons found in part5 html. Summary area shows no comma+capital anomalies.
